introHtml: When you need custom no touch door opener tools but only have a small team or a limited budget, our no-minimum ordering option gives you the flexibility to buy as few as you need—no bulk commitments required. Whether you're outfitting a small office, handing them out at a local event, or testing a design before a larger order, you can get branded door openers without the pressure of high minimums. Each tool, like our popular 7" x 12" Door Knob Bag, helps promote hygiene and your brand simultaneously.
